For \(v = 0.96c\),

\[
\gamma=\frac{1}{\sqrt{1-\beta^2}}=\frac{1}{\sqrt{1-0.96^2}}=\frac{1}{0.28}=3.57142857
\]

“Li with 3 neutrons” means lithium-6, with atomic mass approximately

\[
m_X \approx 6.015122\,u
\]

Using \(1\,u c^2 \approx 931.494\ \text{MeV}\),

\[
m_Xc^2 \approx 6.015122 \times 931.494\ \text{MeV}
\approx 5603.05\ \text{MeV}
= 5.60305\ \text{GeV}
\]

The total relativistic energy is

\[
E=\gamma m_Xc^2
\approx 3.57142857 \times 5.60305\ \text{GeV}
\approx 20.0109\ \text{GeV}
\]

Rounded to the given precision, this is \(20.011\ \text{GeV}\).

Answer: A
